layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Marine piscivore diet symbolism
features: A stylized, cartoonish schooling fish made of smooth clay
The fish is bright golden-yellow clay with a happy round eye and bold, simplified blue stripes along its side
Smooth, chunky fins to maintain a toy-like, friendly aesthetic
Soft studio lighting with gentle highlights
layer_3_action.action: A clean, centered shot of a clay yellow fish sitting on a simple clay surface. The background is a soft, neutral out-of-focus color. The image is designed as a clear icon or symbol to indicate a fish-eating diet for a children's marine matching game. No text.
